lines: These files are public by design, so what gitleaks matches in them is not reported:
appinfo/signature.json, the integrity signature: 6 matches in what ships.
app/appinfo/signature.json, the integrity signature: 2,897 matches in 15 commits.
In these files gitleaks matches values that stand for a credential, such as admin:admin or <password>, so the matches are not reported as secrets:
The values are the list secrets-placeholders.json of ncmake.

These files are test data, the report of a test run or example code, whose keys and tokens are made up or serve a test, so the matches are not reported as secrets. Those of a private key or a GitHub token are:
app/tests/unit/summaryExport.test.js, test data: 1 match in 1 commit (generic-api-key).
A token a test run used against a real server stays valid until it is revoked: where one of these files holds one, revoke it.
